entities.summary: Martha Isabel Peralta Epieyú is a Colombian lawyer, specialist in environmental law and indigenous leader of the Wayuu people belonging to the Epinayú Epieyú clan. She is president of the political party Movimiento Alternativo Indígena y Social (MAIS). Peralta was elected to the Senate in the 2022 legislative election within the coalition of the Historical Pact for Colombia.

entities.summary: Martha Isabel Peralta Epieyú is a Colombian lawyer, specialist in environmental law and indigenous leader of the Wayuu people belonging to the Epinayú Epieyú clan. She is president of the political party Movimiento Alternativo Indígena y Social (MAIS). Peralta was elected to the Senate in the 2022 legislative election within the coalition of the Historical Pact for Colombia.
